_comment: These are the well-known, publicly documented Anvil development accounts. Their
private keys are published in Foundry's documentation, hold no value, and exist so
that a local devnet needs no key generation. They MUST NOT be used on any network
that is not a local devnet.
KAX allocated here is a testnet gas asset with no monetary value. On a network with a
live bridge, KAX in circulation is instead backed by value escrowed in KauraxPortal
on the underlying L2; a genesis allocation exists only so the devnet is usable before

0x42000000000000000000000000000000000000.description: Origin of every L3 -> L2 withdrawal. Its tree root is folded into each output root.
KAURAX-side ERC-20 bridge. Constructor arguments are resolved at genesis time.
